tools.name: search_parts
tools.description: Full-text search over the demo catalogue's provenance-backed part records. Filter by category, build or role. Every attribute returned was corroborated against the manufacturer datasheet or vendor page.

tools.name: get_part
tools.description: The complete canonical record for one part: every attribute with its provenance (source, page, verbatim quote, file hash), vendors with dated indicative prices, and datasheet links.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every category in the catalogue with its part count.

tools.name: list_builds
tools.description: The catalogue's reference builds (robot, weather station, plant waterer) with their roles and candidate parts — the starting point for build_bom.

tools.name: check_compatibility
tools.description: Evaluates a part set against the build's engineering constraints — supply windows, stall vs peak current, shaft/wheel fit, interfaces, solar chain — with a reasoned verdict per check. Every number cited is a corroborated attribute.

tools.name: compare_parts
tools.description: Aligned attribute-by-attribute comparison of two catalogue parts. Absence means the sources did not state a value — never that the part lacks the property.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: The receipt behind a stated value: the verbatim source quote, the page, the extraction method, and the sha-256 of the exact file it was read from — plus a ready-made citation line. Omit code for every attribute's receipt.

tools.name: build_bom
tools.description: Composes a complete BOM for a reference build — quantities, dated indicative prices, per-line rationale, a compatibility verdict for the chosen set, and a CSV export. Override any role with choices.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the Partsgraph demo catalogue. Returns result ids for fetch. Alias of search_parts shaped to the search/fetch connector contract.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch the full provenance-backed record for a search result id as a citable document. Alias of get_part shaped to the search/fetch connector contract.

tools.name: view_bom
tools.description: Composes the BOM for a reference build and renders it as an interactive view in clients that support MCP Apps. Same data as build_bom.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_provenance" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
